split: MedS-Bench test file(s); MedS-Bench-SPLIT has 1,500 + 1,500 (random subsets)
request_fields: Definition (task instruction: chemical or disease NER) + instance input (one sentence)
notes: MedS-Bench (Wu et al., npj Digit Med 2024; arXiv 2408.12547) recasts the dataset as an instruction task. Henrychur/MedS-Bench holds the full test files ("the official benchmark"); Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT holds the subsample used for the paper's results. n_items counts the MedS-Bench file. Two MedS-Bench tasks over the same 4,796 test sentences: chemical NER (4,796) and disease NER (4,796); n_items counts both. ClinicBench also uses BC5-Disease (4,797 sentences, BLURB split) but does not redistribute items. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: instruction-style (MedS-Bench): the task Definition, a blank line, then the instance input (few-shot examples and outputs omitted)
rendering.template_source: none (instruction and input as released in the MedS-Bench task files)
